title: オフィス用複合コピー機
description: 公共施設の事務室・コピー室向けの複合機外観。三段の用紙カセットと開いた取っ手、実形状の排紙空間・ローラー・受け皿、スキャナー蓋とヒンジ、開口した原稿送り部、支持腕付き無表示操作盤、側面扉、背面接続口とキャスターを造形。原稿・印刷物や内部印刷機構は付属せず、読取り・印刷・給排紙・電気機能はありません。安全性・機器性能や認証は示しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.764 × 1.114 × 0.773 m、14,784三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A multifunction-copier exterior for civic office and copy-room interiors. Features three paper cassettes with open pulls, a genuinely open output bay with roller and receiving tray, scanner lid/hinges, open document-feeder throat, supported inactive control panel, side service door, rear connectors and casters. No loose documents or internal print mechanism are included; scanning, printing, paper transport and electrical functions are absent. No safety, performance or certification claims. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.764 × 1.114 × 0.773 m; 14,784 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
